eligibility.quote: The timer as passed in there is not owned by the `Rate` object, it is owned by whatever is creating that (in this case, the Node is the one that calls `create_rate`).  Instead, the user should call `node.destroy_rate(rate)` to properly destroy a previously created Rate object.
